About Glex by Jeeyya

Built by hand, in Marriabad.

Glex by Jeeyya started as a way to bring salon-quality, editorial-level 3D nail art to Quetta — without the wait, and without settling for a generic design off a wall chart.

Every set is sculpted using premium gel and acrylic, then hand-painted and finished with 3D florals, chrome, or crystal work depending on what you bring to the conversation. Sets can be worn as press-ons or applied as a full acrylic service.

Message Jia on WhatsApp with your event, your outfit, or just a mood — she'll sketch the rest.
